meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Notion: hides the Google sign-in pop-up and the marketing site footer (checked on notion.com only; notion.so pages not reachable)
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome with a desktop UA and an iPhone UA on https://www.notion.so/, which redirected to https://www.notion.com/ (the marketing site). The recipe matches only notion.so, so these rules run on logged-out notion.so pages that share the same shell; that was NOT verified. The workspace app and public shared pages need a login or a specific page URL and were not reachable (the network dropped), so no editor rules are included.

- **Google sign-in prompt**: `#g_id_onload` 1 on notion.com (LIVE there; INFERRED for notion.so).
- **Footer**: `footer#site-footer` 1 on notion.com (LIVE there; INFERRED for notion.so).

Not verified: anything inside the Notion app or on shared pages, cookie banners, the hero video (it is on notion.com only). Class names on the marketing site are CSS-module hashes and are not used.
